newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ifo says dollar above 1.90 dmk may spark Buba move.
newsitem.headline: Ifo says dollar above 1.90 dmk may spark Buba move.

text.p: The Ifo economic research institute said on Tuesday that it could imagine that the Bundesbank would take "small steps" to send a signal to currency markets if the dollar rose above 1.90 marks.

Asked at what point the Bundesbank was likely to take action to stem the mark's slide, Ifo economist Willi Leibfritz said: "We're getting close to that point. I could imagine that a dollar above 1.90 marks would set alarm bells ringing in Frankfurt."
Leibfritz said he could imagine that the Bundesbank would "take small steps to give a signal" to marks if the dollar reached that level.
But Leibfritz added that it was hard to assess whether the Bundesbank was likely to move because consumer prices remained weak and bond yields low.
The dollar was trading just over 1.87 marks at 0924 GMT.
